installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Paper Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
PROJECT=paper

if [ -n "${DL_PATH}" ]; then
	echo -e "Using supplied download url: ${DL_PATH}"
	DOWNLOAD_URL=`eval echo $(echo ${DL_PATH} | sed -e 's/{{/${/g' -e 's/}}/}/g')`
else
	VERSIONS_JSON=`curl -s https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}`
	VER_EXISTS=`echo "${VERSIONS_JSON}" | jq -r --arg VERSION "$MINECRAFT_VERSION" '[.versions[][]] | index($VERSION)'`

	if [ "${VER_EXISTS}" != "null" ] && [ -n "${VER_EXISTS}" ]; then
		echo -e "Version is valid. Using version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
	else
		echo -e "Specified version not found. Defaulting to the latest ${PROJECT} version"
		MINECRAFT_VERSION=`echo "${VERSIONS_JSON}" | jq -r '.versions | to_entries | .[0].value[0]'`
	fi

	BUILDS_JSON=`curl -s https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds`

	if [ -n "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ] && [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" != "latest" ]; then
		BUILD_DATA=`echo "${BUILDS_JSON}" | jq -r --arg BUILD "${BUILD_NUMBER}" '[.[] | select((.id|tostring) == $BUILD)][0]'`
		if [ "${BUILD_DATA}" == "null" ]; then
			echo -e "Build ${BUILD_NUMBER} not found for version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}. Defaulting to the latest stable build"
			BUILD_DATA=`echo "${BUILDS_JSON}" | jq -r '[.[] | select(.channel=="STABLE")][0]'`
		else
			echo -e "Build is valid for version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}. Using build ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
		fi
	else
		echo -e "Using the latest ${PROJECT} build for version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
		BUILD_DATA=`echo "${BUILDS_JSON}" | jq -r '[.[] | select(.channel=="STABLE")][0]'`
	fi

	BUILD_NUMBER=`echo "${BUILD_DATA}" | jq -r '.id'`
	JAR_NAME=`echo "${BUILD_DATA}" | jq -r '.downloads."server:default".name'`
	DOWNLOAD_URL=`echo "${BUILD_DATA}" | jq -r '.downloads."server:default".url'`

	echo "Version being downloaded"
	echo -e "MC Version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
	echo -e "Build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
	echo -e "JAR Name of Build: ${JAR_NAME}"
fi

cd /mnt/server

echo -e "Running curl -o ${SERVER_JARFILE} ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [ -f ${SERVER_JARFILE} ]; then
	mv ${SERVER_JARFILE} ${SERVER_JARFILE}.old
fi

curl -o ${SERVER_JARFILE} ${DOWNLOAD_URL}

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
    echo -e "Downloading MC server.properties"
    curl -o server.properties https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkervcp/eggs/master/minecraft/java/server.properties
fi
